name: Tomodachi A
source:
Mofuko's friend, A-chan is an ordinary girl. She doesn't get a sprite until the sequel, "Suki na Otoko no Ko?"

[SPOILER]Though sharp-tongued and blunt, A-chan is frequently worried about Mofuko's terrible taste in men. Sometimes, she tries to advise Mofuko against the latter's choices (occasionally taking direct action), but mostly to no avail. She's pretty much the only "normal" person out of the entire cast.[/SPOILER]
